eligibility_reason: The original Fig.4 numerical findings and complete functional-control families are source-grounded, but original data/identity support, exact aggregation/invocation, acceptance tolerances and a full-cohort independent native-output verifier are missing. The recovered publication v2.0 functions are source components, not computational reproduction evidence.

source_paper.title: Tracking neurons across days with high-density probes

The demo comprises IDs1-5 and two consecutive recordings per mouse; this is not the full 16-mouse result population.
Waveform inputs, unit identity metadata, independent functional validation and author pipeline route.

evidence.locator: function entry and cached-score short circuit; population coupling; lines211-253 ISI; natural image response section; appended MatchTable
evidence.supports: Spike/session joins, native 42-edge ISI recipe in seconds and split halves, complete directed ISICorr, population and visual fingerprints; independent verification must recompute authentic fingerprints rather than accept cached scores.
MATLAB perfcurve numerical ROC/AUC path, including positive/negative class orientation and supplied ROC sample grid; no portable numerical parity is inferred.

target.description: Track putative identical neurons across recordings from spike waveforms; evaluate cross-day match versus nonmatch separation using independent ISI fingerprints. AUC measures functional consistency, not ground-truth identity accuracy.

dataset.description: Original chronic Neuropixels study recordings supporting Fig. 4. Public demo24305758v1 covers IDs1-5; full datasets for IDs1,7,8 are linked in24411841v1, and remaining full recordings are available only on request. The complete Fig. 4 input release is not recovered.

cohort.description: The published cross-day ISI summary uses16 mice. Exact eligible session/location/pair membership must be restored; five mice with two consecutive recordings cannot replace this population.

split.description: Within-recording split-half waveforms calibrate matching; functional validation evaluates original across-day recording pairs. There is no original leave-one-mouse-out improvement split. A new held-mouse fold remains an extension.

inputs.description: Average waveforms at recording sites, position and original unit/session metadata. Functional ISI, population coupling and sensory responses are evaluation information, excluded from matching and candidate selection on final recordings.

preprocessing.description: Preserve independently spike-sorted units, author waveform processing/drift correction, good-unit criteria and the paper-era default matching algorithm. Current pinned functional code and the registered v2/greedy decoder have not been reconciled to the publication version.

metric.description: ROC AUC separating ISI-histogram correlations of matches from nonmatches; use original exclusions and require at least 20 matched units per eligible recording comparison. Within-recording matched units are excluded.

aggregation.description: Retain original recording/location summaries within each mouse and then the16-mouse mean with animal-level uncertainty. Match counts, eligible support and pair/day coverage must be retained; neurons and directed pair entries are not independent replicates.

full_panel.description: Original Fig.4 functional validation and its Extended Data Fig.5 recording-pair support: retain all original eligible recording/location/day pairs for the 16-mouse ISI and population-coupling populations, and the original nine-mouse visual-response subset, without treating it as 16 mice. For each fingerprint retain cross-day matched/nonmatched and within-day same/different-unit distributions and ROC/AUCs, all original match counts and available-unit denominators, recording durations/dates, split-unit exclusions, functional-fingerprint reliability/support, per-location AUC-versus-days fits, per-mouse summaries, population means/SEMs and slope median/dispersion. Preserve the original example unit/neighbor/match fingerprints, example-pair cross/within AUCs and 183-day examples; their exact identities remain unrecovered. Native summaryFunctionalPlots enforces both recording durations >=600 seconds, reassigns intermediate UIDs for each pair, excludes rows by split UID1, and uses match-direction count/2 >=20 with a non-all-NaN functional score. Its groupVector-based pair concatenation and slope-conditioned printed summary need reconciliation with the manuscript location-averaging wording and the actual original Fig.4 invocation. Natural-image eligibility requires the source first-day reliability rule; the exact release branch and complete original masks must be qualified. Granular verification must join every MatchTable row to original animal/location/session/cluster identities, recompute independent fingerprints and directed correlations from authentic spikes/stimuli, retain UID assignments and all exclusion masks, then derive FPSum, deltaDays, numMatchedUnits, maxAvailableUnits and bsave. No full-cohort immutable roster, masks, independent verifier or exact source-output panel is available yet.

permitted_observations.description: Both information conditions receive the same paper, authentic original waveform observations, recording-site positions and original unit/session metadata under an eventual frozen common input manifest. Printed numbers and figure claims are known solver inputs and cannot establish computational reproduction. Matching and candidate selection on final recordings cannot use ISI, population-coupling or visual-response evaluation information. After candidate freeze, an independent operator must execute the submitted analysis against authentic held-aside functional observations and verify native row-level products and derived findings. Author code is the only permitted information addition in paper+data+author-code; the 6ef0023cb4a7be0a94dabbab24bb79c084b6fb1e v2.0 publication lineage is recovered, but neither a complete paired delivery manifest nor an enforced target boundary is established. The five-mouse leave-one-mouse-out demo is separately scoped and cannot define the original observations or split.

blocking_issues: Full original 16-mouse ISI/population-coupling recordings, nine-mouse visual subset, exact eligible location/session-pair rosters and original example identities are unrecovered; the five-mouse/two-day demo cannot substitute.
Original groupVector, duration/date metadata, goodness/reliability exclusions and every native UID/functional row identity remain unbound to immutable authentic manifests.

Manuscript location averaging versus native concatenation of eligible pair AUCs, slope-qualified printed support versus plotted summaries, and exact slope-dispersion convention require original invocation reconciliation.
No independently justified numerical tolerance or reproduction uncertainty criterion exists for any reported mean, SEM, slope, dispersion or example. Source SEM/m.a.d. are not tolerance defaults.

No admitted complete analysis interface/evaluator or independent full-original-cohort output-verification program exists. admission_policy is deliberately absent rather than filled with invented identities. Candidate method is free; verification must establish the frozen original observations, identities, panel and source-consistent findings rather than mandate author-code copying.

Required native verification: independently join original waveform/session/cluster identities; check candidate MatchTable probabilities/UIDs and two-session split exclusions; recompute functional scores from authentic spikes and stimuli (not cached values), including ISI split histograms, directed correlations and companion fingerprints; check 600-second/20-match/reliability eligibility and every excluded row; recompute source ROC/AUC, match counts, available-unit denominators, dates, fits and complete per-mouse/condition aggregates; trace all 27 declared values plus source distributions/example profiles to these products.

The recovered MATLAB AssignUniqueIDAlgorithm, ComputeFunctionalScores(recompute=1), getAUC and summaryFunctionalPlots are concrete source interfaces, but transitive dependencies, MATLAB/toolboxes, source artifact provenance and numerical equivalence are unqualified. The five-mouse independent arithmetic bank cannot verify the original full panel.

Complete paired paper+data versus paper+data+author-code input/code manifests, independent authoring and execution traces, candidate freeze, functional-target isolation, exposure policy and cumulative access/resource budgets remain unfrozen.
